svg.text: Listen: how the project gets built
One box = one GitHub issue, one band = one stage. Read left to right: an arrow means “must be finished before”; boxes in the same column can be done in any order.

Arrows take the colour of the stage they start in; dashed arrows cross into another stage. Thick border = ready to start now. Red border = on the critical path (the longest chain still to do: start there). ✓ = done. Hover a box in a browser to highlight its links.
